LanguageData.MF_BirthdayDefaultSpotHelp: Prefer this location for birthdays on this map. You can change it in preparation. Choose again if the designated spot is removed.
LanguageData.MF_PositionsHelp: Drag a portrait, or click a person then a slot. Occupied slots swap. The top is the backdrop; the bottom is the front row. Carried babies share their guardian’s slot.
LanguageData.MF_PositionsInvalid: An assigned slot is unavailable. Adjust positions or reset to automatic.
LanguageData.MF_SessionHelp: Saves people, positions, location, guardians, expressions, emotes and framing choices in this save. The birthday subject remains the current subject.
LanguageData.MF_SessionMissingSpot: The saved location is not available on this map. Select a location and save a new configuration.
LanguageData.MF_SessionMissingPeople: Excluded {0} unavailable participants. Review the roster before gathering.
LanguageData.MF_BackgroundClearConfirm: Remove the photo backdrop? The photo itself stays, but the position and zoom you set are lost.
LanguageData.MF_BackgroundHelp: Drag the image to position it. Only the upright cloth is filled. Apply stores a dedicated copy without changing the original image.
LanguageData.MF_BackgroundMissing: Background file missing. Choose the image again.
LanguageData.MF_BackgroundTooLarge: Choose an image no larger than 32 MB.
LanguageData.MF_BackgroundFormat: Choose a PNG/JPG image up to 40 megapixels and 16384 pixels per side.
